newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Analysts see flat annual Danish Aug CPI.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Analysts see flat annual Danish Aug CPI.

text.p: Nine economists polled by Reuters on Thursday forecast an unchanged 2.3-percent annual consumer price rise in August, based on the domestic method of calculation.
Month-to-month average August CPI was seen up 0.3 percent from July.
Estimates spanned from 2.2- to 2.4-percent rises on a year-to-year basis and up 0.1-0.3 percent month-to-month.
The Danish national statistics office releases August CPI data at 0730 GMT on Friday.
